data.name: Avigdor
data.gender_notes: Avigdor is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Avigdor is a Hebrew name meaning 'father of light'. It is derived from the Hebrew words av (father) and yad (hand) or yaroch (light). In the Bible, Avigdor is the name of an Edomite king who reigned during the time of King David of Israel. The name is also associated with the biblical prophet Avigdor, who was a descendant of King David and a prophet during the Babylonian exile.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents divine guidance and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Avigdor belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avigdor total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

By embracing this name, we are acknowledging our dependence on God and seeking to align ourselves with His divine will. Ultimately, Avigdor invites us to live our lives as a reflection of God's light and to share that light with others.
